external.note: Owner's n8n workflow 'Claude Image Harness (Webhook)'. URL and key: IMAGE_HARNESS_URL / IMAGE_HARNESS_KEY from the environment or the gitignored config/image-harness.local.env (template config/image-harness.example.env). Never in a tracked file: the repo is public.
Host Python 3. generate.py needs only the standard library for generate; edits with --image/--mask, make_mask.py and make_seamless.py also need Pillow (make_mask/make_seamless numpy too).
Only when uv_island_paint apply requests --ddt. Consumer provides scripts/havok/ddt_patch.py and its tested decoder/encoder dependencies; source PNG painting does not require it.
